recs.title: Your 10 recommended actions
items: Post the 'If you have it, we buy it' card first (block c), leading with the new Trimble SPS930, TX8 and SX12. Two wanted posts (Emlid RS4 Pro, MALÅ GPR) expired on 9–10 Oct with no offers, and all 10 live ones are at 0.
Celebrate the FARO Premium 200 sale (Switzerland → USA) with an anonymous 'Sold' post. Check with Mireille first that listing #2449 is taken down. Hold the MS60 sale (see the note in block a).

Send the weekly Odoo newsletter. Three 'This Week at Topotrade' drafts are queued (28 Sep, 5 Oct, 12 Oct) and none went out. Send the 12 Oct one tomorrow, and delete the older two. The last sends did well: OAGQ 560 recipients, 13.9% click rate.
Add the 'Intergeo 2026' list (109 contacts) to the weekly newsletter, so the INTERGEO follow-ups keep getting listings and wanted items.
Share Zein's WhatsApp broadcast (sent to the team on 11 Oct, 'Copy and share via your WhatsApp this week'). Turn the same text into a LinkedIn and Facebook post.

Website: GA4 shows 182 users / 300 sessions in the last 7 days, 799 users / 1,285 sessions and 11 conversions in the last 30. Make sure the RFP-post and sign-up events fire, and put UTM tags on every social and newsletter link (Odoo leads still carry no source or campaign).
Google Ads is still at $0 (the card was declined on 1 Sep). Prepare a 'Sell your instrument' + 'Wanted' campaign so it's ready when Zein fixes billing.
Instagram is flat (topotrade_ 759 followers; digitalrealities.fr 72). Reuse the sold and wanted cards as Stories and Reels. Reach data isn't available through the API.

Digital Realities: Matterport now sells the Pro3 direct in France at €3,695 HT. Prepare a DR post on what DR adds: stock in France, handover in Paris, scanning services, rental and support. We already have a buyer collecting a Pro3 in Paris on 15–18 Oct. Agree the angle with Daniel.

DR visibility: Google Business Profile had 51 viewers in September, the Facebook page has 30 followers, and GA4 had 3 users on 10 Oct. Plan two DR posts a week, continuing the 29 Sep and 5 Oct 3D-scan series. Also reply to Premium Positioning's partnership draft (8 Oct), or pass it to Zein.
